$comment: Locked RehabNinja chrome. No STEADI, stand counts, ranks, peers, or clinical labels. Patient lines follow content/patient-lines.json rules.

lobby.tagline: Stand in front of your camera. Good moves slice fruit.

week.title: Your week
week.body: Your own progress, plus the crew cheering you on.

home.hint: Fruit on your joints = good form. Bombs when knees drift or hands push off.

trend.same: About the same as last time

ready.title: Before you start
ready.body: Sturdy chair behind you? Someone nearby? Feeling OK to start?

frame.title: We need to see you
frame.body: Stand so your hips, knees, and feet are in the outline.
frame.step_back: Step back until hips and knees are in the outline.
frame.fallback: We could not use the camera, so a demo replay will play instead.

live.how: Clean reps slice fruit. Bombs = knees in or hands pushing off.

coach.sit_to_stand: Stand up — fruit slices when knees stay over your feet.
coach.mini_squat: Squat and rise — slice when you come up with knees out.
coach.single_leg_balance: Hold steady — fruit fills when you stay balanced.

live.tracking_soft: We need a clearer view — step back a little.
live.step_back: Step back so we can see your knees — then keep playing.
live.step_back_ok: Looking good. Continue when you're ready.
live.step_back_wait: We need to see your hips and knees.

close.title: Your session
close.care_team: Your care team can review this session on the clinic board.

note.placeholder: Type, or tap the microphone on your keyboard
note.sent: Your note was sent to your nurse.
note.not_sent: Your note did not go through yet. You can try sending it again.
note.skipped: No note this time. That's okay.

crew.heading: Your crew
crew.intro: People on the same recovery path. Every day you show up counts for everyone.
crew.goal_reached: Your crew reached the goal this week. Nice teamwork.
crew.cheer_limit: That is lots of cheering for today. Try again tomorrow.
crew.cheer_failed: Your cheer did not go through yet. You can try again.
crew.for_you_empty: Cheers from your crew will show up here.
crew.empty: Your crew is just getting started. Others will show up here soon.
crew.error: Your crew could not load right now. You can still play.
crew.report_line: Your crew can see you showed up today.
